claim: In the matching retail DLL, Player.ProcessFoxSleep (0x06004EBE) is a parameterless 177-byte method. It returns unless all of the following raw conditions hold in sequence: isPossibleFoxSleep is nonzero; FoxSleepCnt is greater than zero; animator.isAnmBoot is nonzero; StunTime is greater than zero; animator.BasicSkillID equals numeric 89 or 90; animator.currentFormIdx equals 5; and (padOn & 48) is nonzero. When all gates pass it stores isDisableUpdateDownTime=0, increments animator.FormDispDuration by one, decrements FoxSleepCnt by one, calls ConsumeSP with raw Float32 4.0, and returns. The already-closed FormAnimator.UpdateAnimation body calls this exact method at IL+0x0028 before its reqAnmInit gate.
